data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names only one mutation (identity homogenization via school ID) for only one of the two required refusals (school-to-seat binding). The problem requires the skeleton to include forbidden cases for BOTH untested refusals: the school-to-seat binding AND the frozen route lease whose endpoint drifted. By providing a forbidden case exclusively for the seat-binding mutation and omitting any machine-checkable forbidden case naming a lease-mismatch mutation (e.g., a drift mutation where the lease is honored without the typed mismatch code), the target fails to satisfy the deliverable's explicit two-refusal scope. A complete skeleton must name at least one silent-pass mutation per refusal; SRC_001 leaves the frozen-lease refusal without any forbidden case.
